description:
Confirmed in run 39125986956 (develop 3b3cfbcaa) and canary issue #2887 comment of run 39127140235: four tests fail. (1) tests/integration/test_plan_capture_combined_divergence.py::test_real_combined_power_maintenance_checkpoint_captures_pre_mutation_plan: 'RF2 did not delete the identified oldest order - test setup invalid' (remaining == 1). (2) tests/integration/test_tpc_compliance_integration.py::TestTPCHCompliance::test_tpch_maintenance_test_integration: result.rf2_operations == 0 with errors ["RF1 pair 1 failed: 'Mock' object is not subscriptable"]. (3) tests/integration/test_tpch_official_benchmark.py::TestTPCHOfficialBenchmark::test_all_phases_enabled: phases.maintenance.return_value.run_maintenance_test.called is False. (4) tests/integration/test_tpch_refresh_integration.py::test_dbgen_update_sets_succeed_with_long_output_paths: assert 108 > 111 (the runner's tmp path is shorter than the hardcoded padding assumes).
The canary failure set changed day to day since 2026-10-09 (last green c419dd2d1), so these are several regressions, not one. Whether (1)-(3) are product regressions or stale tests is NOT established (INFERENCE: (4) is a test-environment assumption).
GATE-E per failure: bisect or inspect the culprit change in c419dd2d1..3b3cfbcaa and classify product regression vs test defect with evidence. Product regression: fix the product and keep the test. Test defect: edit the test only when the culprit PR/commit states the behavior change was intentional; otherwise treat it as a product bug. Ambiguous: create a finding follow-up and block this item; never edit a test to make it pass without that evidence (G6). For (4) compute the padding from the actual temp base length while preserving the long-path intent (confirm the intent from the test and its history).
